Context: 11. Payment of Pension

Interest payable on delayed payment of DCRG.If the payment of DCRG has been delayed beyond three months from the date of.retirement, an interest at the rate applicable to GPF deposits determined from time to time will be paid to the retired employee / dependants of deceased employee. Responsibility will be fixed and the amount of interest recovered from the concerned Dealing Official, Supervisor and Head of Office in proportion of their salary. - GID, Rule 18 and GID (1), Rule 65.
